quest.title: Going Upon the Breeze
quest.description: The girl's name is Amber, and her duty as an Outrider is to escort you to Mondstadt. However, she has another task to attend to first, which is to clean out the hilichurls that have been wandering around outside the city.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Primogem x20, Mora x1800, Unknown Item #15303 x1, Character EXP x925, Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: The Outlander Who Caught the Wind

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Though I've gotta say, you surprised me a little with your moves there...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Thanks for the backup. How'd it feel?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that you mention it, how is it the hilichurls ended up here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: These creatures don't seem like the type to set up camp so close to cities like this.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Exactly. It's more normal for them to be much further out in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But because the dragon — Stormterror — has been around a lot more recently, our orchards have been destroyed and the local market has been affected as well.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: When the storms hit, we usually end up with at least a few injuries, so the Knights of Favonius have been tied up doing the best they can to defend the area.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So these annoying creatures have been getting closer and closer to the city?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Exactly. That said, clearing this camp helped make the area a little bit safer.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Come with me! A responsible knight must make sure to see you to the city safely.

choices.text: Those things are tougher than they look.

talks.objective: Clear out the nearby hilichurl camp
